rationale: The frozen Alfabet product description expressly claims AI technologies for SPM. Official Alfabet documentation confirms an AI Assistant in the help experience; separate AI Portfolio Management requires a license and activation and is not the sole basis. Retain version/configuration limitation.
ai_type_rationale: Enterprise architecture and strategic portfolio management retain meaningful core value without AI; AI capabilities enhance rather than define the broader core.
version_scope: Record has no version/date. Official documentation is Alfabet 11.13/11.9; availability varies by deployment and licensing.
issues: Version, SKU and deployment configuration are unknown; conditional Portfolio Management use case is not universal.
